description: This file is a code-behind for a Razor Page in ASP.NET Core, handling user interactions related to the shopping basket, including displaying basket contents, adding items, and updating item quantities.

classes.name: IndexModel
classes.description: A Razor Page model class responsible for managing the shopping basket page, including retrieving basket data, adding items, and updating quantities.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve or create a basket for the current user.

methods.name: OnPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a specified CatalogItem to the user's basket.

methods.name: OnPostUpdate
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update quantities of items in the user's basket.

methods.name: GetOrSetBasketCookieAndUserName
methods.description: Determines and returns the user's basket identifier, setting a new cookie if necessary, handling both authenticated and anonymous users.
